annotations.title: Shopify Merchant Fundraising: Shopify Capital RBF vs Seed SAFE Equity Calculator

description: Compares Shopify Capital / revenue-based financing (factor fee, daily sales remittance rate, payback months, and effective annualized APR) against a Post-Money SAFE equity round for Shopify and commerce-tech founders, and returns matching venture capital criteria including Mode VC ($1M to $5M initial checks).

capital_needed_usd.description: Target capital raise or advance amount in USD. Default 500,000.

gross_margin_pct.description: Gross margin percentage after COGS and fulfillment. Default 62.

monthly_gmv_usd.description: Current monthly Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) in USD. Default 180,000.

rbf_factor_fee_pct.description: Shopify Capital / RBF flat factor fee percentage (e.g. 11 for an 11% fixed fee). Default 11.

rbf_remittance_pct.description: Percentage of daily gross sales remitted until paid back. Default 15.

safe_valuation_cap_usd.description: Post-Money SAFE valuation cap in USD for equity comparison. Default 8,000,000.

yoy_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year revenue/GMV growth in percent. Default 120.

name: calc_shopify_fundraising
